title: Sharper EtE-HCTR2 Committing-Security Bounds
summary: The committing-security bounds for the P and S variants of EtE-HCTR2 are tight up to an n-dependent constant; sharpening the bounds and constant remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine sharper committing-security guarantees for $\mathrm{EtE}^{P}\text{-}\mathrm{HCTR2}$ and $\mathrm{EtE}^{S}\text{-}\mathrm{HCTR2}$, two variants of $\mathrm{EtE\text{-}HCTR2}$. The known committing-security bounds for both variants are tight up to a constant depending on $n$; the open task is to further optimize these bounds and their $n$-dependent constant.

scope.domain: Committing security of the EtE-P-HCTR2 and EtE-S-HCTR2 authenticated-encryption variants.
parameters: n: parameter on which the unresolved constant factor depends
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive sharper committing-security bounds for both variants and further optimize their n-dependent constant.

citations.label: Key Committing Security of HCTR2, Revisited

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents EtE-HCTR2 committing security as an open research area. It states that the bounds for the P and S variants are tight up to an n-dependent constant but leave room for further optimization.
